# omada_lan_network (Resource)

Manages a LAN network (VLAN) on the Omada controller via the V3 Open API workflow (check → confirm), including the DHCP Server Device (`device_type`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# DHCP Server Device — the network's "DHCP Server Device" setting is driven by
# `device_type`. Supported values: external_device, gateway, switch, none.

# none — no DHCP server on this L2-only VLAN (addresses served elsewhere).
resource "omada_lan_network" "vlan_dhcp_none" {
  name        = "IOT"
  vlan_id     = 30
  device_type = "none"
}

# external_device — an upstream/external DHCP server serves this VLAN.
resource "omada_lan_network" "vlan_dhcp_external" {
  name        = "Guest"
  vlan_id     = 40
  device_type = "external_device"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID (1-4094).

### Optional

- `device_type` (String) DHCP Server Device: `external_device`, `gateway`, `switch`, or `none`.
- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the DHCP server on this network.
- `dhcp_end` (String) Last address of the DHCP pool.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First address of the DHCP pool.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the controller's primary site.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller-assigned network ID.
- `site_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by network ID (uses the controller's primary site):
terraform import omada_lan_network.iot 692c13f575ee724076c80d2d

# Or scope to a named site: "<site_name>/<network_id>"
terraform import omada_lan_network.iot 'Home/692c13f575ee724076c80d2d'
```
